notice: Every product below is either a scored input, a quality or uncertainty input, or display context. Display context never enters a number.

roles.label: Earth elevation model
roles.product: NASA SRTMGL1.003 (Shuttle Radar Topography Mission, 1 arc-second)
roles.measures: Ground elevation in metres (EGM96 geoid) from C-band radar interferometry flown in February 2000.

why.terrain_analogy: Slope and relative elevation are derived from it on the same physical grid as the Jezero DEM, so landform shape can be compared without comparing absolute heights.
why.balanced_science: Supplies the terrain family only (30 % of the planned evidence).
why.rover_mobility: Gives broad terrain context at 60 m; it cannot see wheel-scale obstacles.
why.biosignature_fieldwork: Terrain is 10 % of this profile and not task-critical.
why.mars_base_field_testing: Supplies the terrain family only (35 % of the planned evidence).

roles.native_resolution: 1 arc-second (about 30 m; 28-31 m east-west at the sites)
roles.analysis_resolution: 60 m primary grid; 120 and 240 m as sensitivity checks; 1.2 km halo
roles.footprint: Each 10 km Earth study window plus a 1.2 km halo; coverage 60 N to 56 S
cannot_establish: rocks or obstacles smaller than the grid
changes after February 2000 (for example later construction or mining)

roles.label: Jezero elevation model
roles.product: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM mosaic, 20 m (USGS, Calef 2021)
roles.measures: Mars surface elevation from Context Camera stereo, on an equirectangular grid true to scale at 18.4663 N.

why.terrain_analogy: Defines the reference window's slope and relative-elevation distributions on the same 60 m physical grid as the Earth windows.
why.balanced_science: Planetary side of the terrain family.
why.rover_mobility: Planetary side of the broad terrain context.
why.biosignature_fieldwork: Planetary side of the terrain family (not task-critical).
why.mars_base_field_testing: Planetary side of the terrain family.

roles.native_resolution: 20 m posting (stereo effective resolution is coarser)
roles.analysis_resolution: 60 m primary grid; 120 and 240 m sensitivity
roles.dates: Mosaic published 2021-10-14 from CTX images acquired 2006 onward
roles.footprint: 10 km window at 18.44 N, 77.45 E inside Jezero crater near the delta front
used_in: resolution floor: the same window moved 2 km N/S/E/W
cannot_establish: ancient lake conditions (it records today's surface)
rock size, soil strength or dust

roles.label: Additional Mars elevation models
roles.product: USGS Astrogeology controlled CTX DTMs (STAC mro_ctx_controlled_usgs_dtms), 20 m, CC0-1.0, DOI 10.5066/P9JKVWR3
roles.measures: Mars surface elevation from Context Camera stereo pairs, controlled to MOLA; heights above the areoid where a geoid-adjusted asset exists.

why.terrain_analogy: Define the Gale, InSight, Gusev and Eberswalde reference windows on the same 60 m physical grid as the Earth windows.
why.balanced_science: Planetary side of the terrain family.
why.rover_mobility: Planetary side of the broad terrain context.
why.biosignature_fieldwork: Planetary side of the terrain family (not task-critical).
why.mars_base_field_testing: Planetary side of the terrain family.

roles.native_resolution: 20 m posting; stereo effective resolution is coarser and short-wavelength noise is present
roles.analysis_resolution: 60 m primary grid; 120 and 240 m sensitivity
roles.dates: CTX stereo images 2006 onward; products published 2023-2024
roles.footprint: One 10 km window per reference, read with HTTP range requests (no bulk download)
used_in: resolution floor: each window moved 2 km N/S/E/W
cannot_establish: ancient environments (they record the present surface)

roles.label: Lunar south-pole elevation model
roles.measures: Lunar surface elevation from laser altimetry, polar stereographic, true scale at the pole.

why.terrain_analogy: Measured lunar terrain distances only. Four 2 km placement shifts fail the tolerance/resolution-floor gate; no lunar index. Illumination and alternate lunar DEM checks remain unavailable.

roles.native_resolution: 20 m posting; many cells are interpolated between laser tracks
roles.footprint: 10 km window at the lunar south pole (Shackleton rim area)
used_in: Lunar terrain distances and reference-placement sensitivity; no score

roles.label: Alternative Earth elevation models
roles.product: NASADEM_HGT.001 and Copernicus DEM GLO-30 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
roles.measures: The same windows from two other DEM products (NASADEM: reprocessed SRTM; GLO-30: TanDEM-X 2011-2015).

why.terrain_analogy: Their disagreement with SRTM sets the DEM part of the resolution floor: distances smaller than it cannot separate sites.

cannot_establish: which DEM is correct; their spread is a product uncertainty, not ground truth

roles.label: Land cover (built-up mask)
roles.product: ESA WorldCover 10 m v200 (2021) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
roles.measures: Eleven land-cover classes at 10 m, from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 (2021).

why.terrain_analogy: Analysis cells with at least half their area mapped built-up (class 50) are excluded before terrain derivatives; no additional buffer. Unmapped industrial terrain remains a limitation.

roles.analysis_resolution: Aggregated to the 60 m grid; built-up area fraction >= 0.5 excludes a cell.
cannot_establish: mines, heaps and graded ground, which are usually classed as bare land (the original Atacama complex was missed this way)

roles.label: Detailed Earth image
roles.product: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A true colour (B04/B03/B02) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
roles.measures: Surface reflectance in visible bands on one date.

why.terrain_analogy: Shows the selected window and lets people check it for contamination (it revealed the industrial complex in the original Atacama window). Its colours are not part of any score.
why.biosignature_fieldwork: True colour cannot identify minerals or biosignatures.

roles.analysis_resolution: displayed at 10 m on the analysis grid; not analysed
roles.dates: One scene per site, 2025-11 to 2026-11 (shown on each image)
cannot_establish: conditions on any other date; it is not live

roles.label: Latest broad Earth image
roles.product: NASA GIBS VIIRS NOAA-20 Corrected Reflectance (true colour)
roles.measures: Daily visible reflectance at about 375 m.

why.terrain_analogy: Recent regional context around the window. A 10 km window is only about 27 pixels across, so it shows far less detail than the 10 m scene.

roles.dates: Latest available day from the GIBS capabilities (may be cloudy)
cannot_establish: anything inside the window at metre scale

why.terrain_analogy: Shows the reference window. Not part of any score.

roles.label: Earth surface temperature
roles.product: MODIS/Aqua MYD11A2.061 land surface temperature, 8-day, 1 km
roles.measures: Clear-sky skin temperature in kelvin, day (~13:30) and night (~01:30) passes, 2024.

why.mars_base_field_testing: Planned thermal family. It fails the comparability audit against MEDA (1 km area mean vs a point beside the rover; clear-sky composites vs all-condition sols), so it is shown as context only.
why.balanced_science: Planned thermal family; context only for the same reason.

roles.label: Jezero ground temperature
roles.product: Mars 2020 MEDA TIRS calibrated ground temperature (PDS Atmospheres Node)
roles.measures: Ground skin temperature measured from the rover mast at a few square metres.

why.mars_base_field_testing: Planetary side of the thermal audit; spatial support and sampling do not match MODIS, so context only.

roles.footprint: Rover positions inside the Jezero window

roles.label: Mars global elevation (check)
roles.product: MGS MOLA global DEM mosaic, 463 m (USGS)
roles.measures: Laser altimetry elevation of Mars at 463 m.

why.terrain_analogy: Regional cross-check of CTX slopes at 480 m over 30 km; not scored.

cannot_establish: anything at the 60 m analysis scale

roles.label: Globe textures
roles.product: NASA Blue Marble (GIBS), USGS Viking colour mosaic, NASA SVS LROC WAC

why.terrain_analogy: Orientation only. They are not observations of a study window and never enter a number.

roles.native_resolution: about 500 m to 10 km per pixel

roles.label: Published research context
roles.product: Peer-reviewed papers and agency pages listed on the Sources page (for example Sun & Stack 2020 USGS SIM 3464 for Jezero)
roles.measures: Findings about a region, usually not about our exact 10 km window.

why.biosignature_fieldwork: Explains why a region has been used for method testing. It is kept apart from window measurements and never scored.
why.terrain_analogy: Context for why a window was chosen; not evidence that it matches.

cannot_establish: properties of the exact study window
